package.name: ConverterFlow Mesh Check
package.description: Reports why a mesh is not a solid, instead of only telling you that it is not. Counts boundary edges and the loops they form, non-manifold edges, disconnected shells and inconsistent winding, and prints the bounding box and volume. The analysis runs locally; nothing is uploaded.

macro.name: ConverterFlow Mesh Check
macro.description: Select a mesh, run the macro, read the report in the Report view.
